checklist.assertion: The joined boundary entity is exactly component_identity_candidate; this does not accept a component identity or reclassify the Event Media composition.
The versioned draft candidate states one bounded semantic role and explicit composition exclusions.
The draft candidate records explicit non-goals that prevent placements, semantic modes and adjacent product media from becoming the same identity.

Source and requirement evidence is present, but the relevant derived provenance blocker remains still_open_with_exact_missing_evidence; exact per-cell runtime authority or reasoned non-applicability is absent.

The joined component identity candidate boundary is evidence-backed, but every relevant owner card remains pending, unselected and without a decision receipt; a recommendation or visual card is not acceptance.
The draft candidate explicitly binds anatomy, slots, ownership and composition exclusions.
The draft candidate binds props, defaults, state axes, valid and invalid combinations, fixtures and extension limits.
Pinned source evidence and consumer refs bound the proposed implementation membership without authorizing a merge, split or migration.
The complete Event Media census includes each consumer referenced by the candidate; census completeness does not decide the identity boundary.
Every candidate consumer ref resolves to a census row with source, routes or an explicit source-only/lifecycle context.
The draft candidate has machine-readable state axes and required interaction or non-interaction behavior.
Consumer/container behavior is drafted, but the candidate-relevant derived responsive, layout or runtime evidence blockers remain terminally open with exact missing evidence.
Accessibility requirements are explicit, but required browser/runtime reconciliation remains missing under the derived runtime blocker.
The deterministic decision boards were reviewed at full resolution, but are decision evidence only and cannot close the derived production-equivalent runtime blocker.

Typed Project Normalization findings remain open and every relevant derived evidence blocker is still_open_with_exact_missing_evidence or every relevant owner blocker is pending; no field-only closure is used.

Relevant owner decision blockers are not absent: every exact owner card remains PENDING_OWNER_DECISION with accepted option and receipt null; an empty evidence-blocker array could not substitute for this join.
